derivation: The highest release below the earliest compromised version.
The registry publishes a digest for this file and the downloaded bytes reproduce it.

This artifact's record carries no package field, so the name was taken from its own artifact id, bittensor-wallet, which resolves to a real package in the pypi registry the record names. The compromised versions themselves are no longer published there, which is consistent with the incident, so the identity rests on the id and the ecosystem rather than on finding those versions.
